title: INC Lahore Session 1929
definition: The Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress (INC) held in December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, marked a paradigm shift from 'Dominion Status' to 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) as the official goal of the national movement.
importanceInUpsc: It is a watershed moment in Indian history, marking the transition from constitutional agitation to mass civil disobedience, frequently tested for its ideological shift and the subsequent launch of the Civil Disobedience Movement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of INC Lahore Session 1929.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
